_readme: Config sources: 'config_repo' = git base branch; each env = base OVERLAID with its OCI bucket (<prefix>configuration/ + override_configuration/ + .delete tombstones). Used by tooling/validation/config_sync.py and tooling/triage/qa_sync.py. QA prefixes verified by `oci os object list` on 2026-10-07. Extra 'tenants' share the bucket under their own prefix.
